I am an old man with no schooling, farming this small maize plot near my house in the middle belt. I will buy a little NPK and urea if the agro-dealer has it under the subsidy, because maize without fertilizer gives almost nothing on this tired land, but I cannot afford a full bag for such a small plot. I will save seed from last year — improved seed is too costly and I do not always trust what they sell. My wife and children will help me weed; I may call one or two young men from the village for the first weeding if the grass is heavy.
